name: Routing — deep links load without landing-page dependency

planSteps.description: The browser URL path is /catalog and the page shows "COMPONENT CATALOG".
The browser URL path is /dynamic and the page shows "Canvas is empty".
The browser URL path is /fixed and the page shows "Room Designer".
Click the Plana brand in the top navigation.
The browser URL path returns to / and the landing page headline shows "Design your room".
